avoid_when: Dense text pages (distraction); high-traffic sites (per-pointer state overhead).

name: TextPressure-TS-TW

avoid_when: On touch devices without hover capability or when using fonts without variable axes.

avoid_when: When all words need to be readable simultaneously or when constant motion might distract.

name: VariableProximity-TS-TW

avoid_when: Touch-only devices without cursor support or fonts without variable axes.

name: Shuffle-TS-TW

name: DecayCard-TS-TW

name: FlowingMenu-TS-TW

name: tooltip

name: comp-13

description: Input with € prefix and EUR suffix text overlays for currency formatting.

name: comp-22

use_when: You want a clearer visual separation between input and action, or the button needs to be independently styled.
avoid_when: Space is tight or you need a merged input+button look.

name: comp-23
title: Password Visibility Toggle
blurb: Password input that toggles between masked and visible text.
description: A password field with an eye icon button that toggles between password and text input types. Tracks visibility state with useState.
use_when: Users need to verify their typed password before submitting a login or signup form.
avoid_when: You need to support paste-based passwords or accessibility requirements that disallow unmasked passwords.
a11y: Label linked to input. Button has aria-pressed, aria-label (dynamic), and aria-controls. Icons marked aria-hidden.

name: comp-24
title: Clearable Text Input

use_when: Forms where users frequently need to reset fields or delete accidental input.
avoid_when: Required fields that should not be clearable or the input is read-only.
a11y: Label linked to input. Button has aria-label. Icon marked aria-hidden. Button hidden when input is empty.

name: comp-25
title: Search Keyboard Shortcut Input

description: A search input with a read-only kbd element showing ⌘K in the end. The shortcut display is purely visual and non-interactive.

avoid_when: The keyboard shortcut handler is not actually implemented elsewhere in the app.
a11y: Label linked to input. Kbd is pointer-events-none. Shortcut text is not actionable from the input.

name: comp-27
title: Search Input With Loader
blurb: Search input that shows a spinning loader when text is entered.
description: A search field with a magnifying glass that becomes a spinning LoaderCircleIcon on input. A mic button on the right for voice search. Loading state is simulated with useEffect.

avoid_when: The loader timing doesn't match your actual API call duration (500ms is hardcoded).
a11y: Label linked to input. Loader has role='status' and aria-label. Icons marked aria-hidden where appropriate. Mic button has aria-label.

name: comp-32
title: Floating Label Input

name: comp-28

name: comp-34

title: Text 3D
blurb: Text appears in 3D perspective with depth.
description: Renders text with CSS 3D transforms or canvas to create depth and perspective, often with rotation.
use_when: Hero headings or showcase sections that need visual impact.
avoid_when: Small or body text: 3D transforms reduce legibility.
a11y: Text is present but skewed perspective can hurt readability.

name: text-glitch
title: Text Glitch
blurb: Text shifts and tears with animated clip-path disruptions, red and cyan shadows…
description: Renders text with layered ::before and ::after pseudos that animate clip-path insets to create a digital glitch effect. Activates continuously or on hover with configurable speed.
use_when: Cyberpunk or gaming interfaces, dystopian themes, headline text that needs aggressive visual impact.
avoid_when: Continuous body text; animation harms readability. Component hardcodes dark backgrounds.
a11y: Text is rendered in the DOM and accessible; animation cannot be paused with prefers-reduced-motion.

name: components-backgrounds-hole
title: Hole Background
blurb: Discs and particles stream through an elliptical hole, animated continuously.
description: Canvas-based background with concentric discs tweening downward through a central hole and particles falling through. Runs a continuous RAF loop with radial gradient overlays.
use_when: A dramatic, animated page background that should command visual attention without user interaction.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive pages or mobile devices: the RAF loop runs constantly and never idles, consuming significant…
a11y: Passive background wrapper; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. Continuous animation may cause motion sickness; no prefers-reduced-motion guard.

name: components-backgrounds-bubble
title: Bubble Background
blurb: Animated blur orbs float and pulse across the background.
description: Motion/react background with six configurable color orbs using blur effects. Optional interactive mode for pointer tracking with spring physics.
use_when: Modern gradient background with soft blob aesthetic.
avoid_when: Performance-critical pages or high frame rate requirements.
a11y: Decorative animation; pointer tracking has no keyboard equivalent.

name: components-backgrounds-hexagon
title: Hexagon Background
blurb: Tessellating hexagons that lighten on hover.
description: Renders a responsive grid of clip-path hexagons that fills the viewport. Each hexagon lightens on hover with a smooth transition.
use_when: A geometric background that needs subtle interaction to draw attention to hovered areas.
avoid_when: When the viewport is very small or performance is critical: the grid recalculates on resize and may be heavy on mobile.
a11y: Passive background wrapper; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. No prefers-reduced-motion guard on hover effects.

name: components-backgrounds-gravity-stars
title: Gravity Stars Background
blurb: Stars drift and orbit under simulated gravity, attracted or repelled by cursor.
description: Canvas-based particle system with physics simulation. 75 stars affected by gravity, with optional mouse attraction/repulsion and star-to-star bounce or merge interactions.
use_when: Interactive space-themed background with physics simulation.
avoid_when: Performance-constrained devices or when static background needed.
a11y: Cursor-based interaction has no keyboard equivalent.

name: components-backgrounds-fireworks
title: Fireworks Background
blurb: Continuous random colored particles explode from the screen with physics.
description: Canvas-based particle system with gravity and friction physics. Generates random RGB colored explosions that decay over time, simulating fireworks effect.
use_when: Celebratory or playful animated background.
avoid_when: Serious or minimal aesthetic design, or photosensitive users.
a11y: Decorative particle animation; no motion-reduced variant.

name: components-community-flip-card
title: Flip Card
blurb: Profile card that flips on hover/click to reveal stats and social links.
description: A card displaying front (name, image, bio) and back (stats, social links) sides. Flips on hover (desktop) or click (touch). Shows following, followers, and posts. Includes social media links.
use_when: Team pages, community showcases, or profile networks where flip-reveal adds engagement.
avoid_when: When all info should be immediately visible: flipping hides content.
a11y: Flip mechanism should be keyboard-accessible. Social links are proper anchors.

name: components-community-notification-list
title: Notification List
blurb: Stacked notification cards that fan out and scale on hover with spring…
description: Motion-animated notification list with stacked card layout that expands on hover, each card scales and offsets via spring physics. Shows title, subtitle, time, optional count indicator.
use_when: You need a compact notification center that expands to show full list on interaction.
avoid_when: For always-visible notification lists; use static or popover-based layouts instead.
a11y: Hover interaction only; no keyboard alternative provided. Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.

name: components-community-pin-list
title: Pin List
blurb: List items snap to top when clicked to pin, spring-animated into place.
description: Interactive list where items toggle between pinned (top section) and unpinned (bottom section). Uses Framer Motion's layout animation to smoothly reorder items and shift sections. Pinned items show solid pins; unpinned items reveal the pin…
use_when: Organizing frequently-used items (nav, bookmarks, favorites) where users control visibility priority.
avoid_when: Very large lists (layout animations scale poorly) or touch-only interfaces (pin toggle targets are small).
a11y: Items are clickable divs, not buttons; focus and keyboard navigation not implemented. Layout animations do not respect prefers-reduced-motion.

name: components-community-radial-intro
title: Radial Intro
blurb: Images orbit around a center point in a continuous loop.
description: Animates items in orbital motion around a central stage. Uses Framer Motion spring physics for smooth rotation and item appearance.
use_when: Logo walls, team showcases, or circular feature displays.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (continuous, no prefers-reduced-motion); low-bandwidth (animation overhead).
a11y: Purely decorative animation loop. No interactive elements.

name: components-community-share-button
title: Share Button
blurb: Share button reveals Github, X, and Facebook icons on hover.
description: A Framer Motion-powered button that swaps between a label and animated social icons on hover, with staggered entrance animations and spring physics.
use_when: You need an engaging way to show social share options without taking up initial space.
avoid_when: On touch-only devices where hover is not reliable; the icons only appear on mouse enter.
a11y: Button triggers content swap but no aria attributes for icon meanings. Social icons clickable but unlabeled beyond the platform name in context.

name: components-community-radial-nav
title: Radial Nav
blurb: Circular menu with animated pointer, items orbit at configurable distance.
description: Radial navigation showing menu items arranged in a circle around a central pointer. Pointer rotates toward active item with spring physics. Click items to activate.
use_when: Unique 360° navigation UX or control panels where circular layout fits the domain.
avoid_when: Standard linear navigation; radial menus surprise users and reduce scannability.
a11y: Menu items are keyboard-navigable and have aria-label. Root menu has aria-label. Pointer is aria-hidden.

name: primitives-animate-code-block
title: Animated Code Block
blurb: Code block that types out line-by-line then syntax-highlights with Shiki.
description: Animated code display that optionally types out code character-by-character. Supports Shiki syntax highlighting with light/dark theme variants. Emits callbacks during typing (onWrite) and on completion (onDone). Triggers animation when…
use_when: Tutorial pages or documentation showing how-to code examples with playful reveal.
avoid_when: Very long code files (1000+ lines): typing animation will run too long.
a11y: Code text is fully rendered in DOM, readable by screen readers. No aria-live for typing progress: final highlighted HTML is semantic.

props.name: onWrite
props.type: (info: {index: number; length: number; done: boolean}) => void

name: primitives-effects-click
title: Click
blurb: Click effects animate on interaction with ripple, ring, burst, or particle…
description: Renders animated effects on click within child elements. Supports multiple effect variants (ripple, ring, crosshair, burst, particles) with customizable color, size, and duration.
use_when: Buttons or interactive elements where visual feedback on click enhances perceived interactivity and response.
avoid_when: Contexts where animation might distract from critical interactions.
a11y: Click effects are visual feedback only; focus and keyboard interaction work normally on child content.

name: primitives-effects-image-zoom
title: Image Zoom
blurb: Image zooms in on hover or click, scaling smoothly from the pointer position.
description: Wraps an image and applies spring-animated zoom on hover/click. The zoom origin follows pointer position, creating a smooth magnification effect.
use_when: Product galleries, portfolio images, or detail-heavy imagery where zoom magnification aids discovery.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces with no hover (though click zoom is supported).
a11y: Zoom is visual enhancement; alt text and semantic content depend on child image.

title: Highlight

blurb: Highlights child items with animated background that tracks hover or click…
description: Context-based component providing highlight functionality to child items. Items track hover/click state with smooth animated background transitions.
use_when: Tab lists, navigation items, or menu-like components where highlighting active/hovered items provides clear visual…
avoid_when: Static content that does not require interactivity feedback.
a11y: Highlight is visual; semantic meaning depends on child content structure.

name: primitives-effects-shine
title: Shine
blurb: Animated shine effect sweeps across content, continuously or on hover/click.
description: Renders an animated shine/gloss effect that sweeps across child content. Runs continuously, on hover, or on click with customizable color, opacity, and direction.
use_when: Buttons, cards, or premium UI elements where a shine effect adds perceived polish and draws visual attention.
avoid_when: Content already using shine effects where layering might create visual noise.
a11y: Shine effect is purely visual; no impact on semantic content or keyboard interaction.

name: primitives-effects-theme-toggler
title: Theme Toggler
blurb: Theme switcher with View Transition API animations and direction options.
description: Primitive component for theme management with optional View Transition API animations. Accepts theme state and direction prop to customize clip animation path.
use_when: Building theme switchers that need smooth transitions between light/dark/system modes with directional animations.
avoid_when: When View Transition API is not supported or when browser compatibility is a concern.
a11y: Render function receives theme state and toggleTheme callback. Accessibility depends on how the render function is implemented.

name: primitives-headless-checkbox
title: Headless Checkbox
blurb: Animated checkbox with Headless UI and Framer Motion with indeterminate support.
description: Checkbox primitive using Headless UI with Framer Motion animations. Supports checked and indeterminate states with path animations. Renders render function children.
use_when: Building custom checkbox designs with smooth animations and multi-state support.
avoid_when: When you need simple unstyled checkboxes without animation overhead.
a11y: Built on Headless UI checkbox primitive which provides full keyboard and screen reader support.

title: Headless Dialog

blurb: Dialog flips in from a direction with 3D perspective and blur.
description: Headless UI dialog wrapped with Framer Motion that animates panel entrance with 3D perspective rotation. Direction configurable (top/bottom/left/right). Backdrop fades with blur. Composed header, title, description, and footer.
use_when: You want a polished modal with directional entrance animations that feel dimensional.
avoid_when: Older browsers or performance-sensitive contexts: 3D perspective has render costs.
a11y: Built on Headless UI primitives with full keyboard support (Escape closes). Render prop pattern on DialogPanel for advanced composition.

name: primitives-headless-disclosure
title: Headless Disclosure
blurb: Headless disclosure component for custom styling.
description: Animate UI's disclosure primitive: unstyled button + panel wrapper for complete custom control.
use_when: Building fully custom disclosure interactions without predefined styling.
avoid_when: When you want pre-styled components.
a11y: Headless primitives require manual aria handling.

name: primitives-headless-popover
title: Headless Popover
blurb: Floating panel scales in from center with spring animation.
description: Headless UI popover with Framer Motion animations. Panel scales and fades in/out with spring physics. Supports backdrop, button, and group composition for managing multiple popovers.
use_when: You need a lightweight, accessible popover with smooth scale animation.
avoid_when: Fixed positioning is needed: this uses absolute positioning anchored to parent.
a11y: Full Headless UI popover accessibility: keyboard navigation, focus management, Escape closes.

name: primitives-headless-switch
title: Headless Switch
blurb: Animated toggle switch with composable thumb and icon components.
description: Switch primitive using Headless UI with Framer Motion. Features composable SwitchThumb and SwitchIcon components with spring animations.
use_when: Building premium animated switches with custom icon positioning and fine-tuned motion control.
avoid_when: When you need a simple switch without animation or custom composition.
a11y: Built on Headless UI switch primitive with full keyboard and screen reader support.

name: primitives-radix-progress
title: Radix Progress
blurb: Animated progress bar using Radix UI with spring motion fills.
description: A progress bar component wrapping Radix UI's Progress primitive with Framer Motion-animated indicator fill that uses spring physics for smooth transitions.
use_when: Building accessible progress bars with polished animated fills.
avoid_when: When static progress bars are sufficient.
a11y: Built on Radix UI primitives with full accessibility support.

name: primitives-texts-gradient
title: Gradient Text
blurb: Text fills with an animated gradient.
description: Applies a multi-stop gradient to text with animation that shifts color positions over time, creating a flowing color effect.
use_when: Eye-catching headlines or premium branding elements.
avoid_when: Low-contrast environments or accessibility-critical labels: gradients reduce readability.
a11y: Text is readable but gradient may reduce contrast. Animation runs uncontrolled.

name: primitives-texts-highlight
title: Highlight Text
blurb: Text glows with a highlight that pulses behind it.
description: Renders text with a backdrop glow or highlight that animates in and out, emphasizing key words.
use_when: Accent words or phrases within body copy that deserve visual pop.
avoid_when: Full headings: a highlight every few words becomes chaotic.
a11y: Text is readable. Animation is decorative with no interaction barrier.

name: primitives-texts-rolling
title: Rolling Text
blurb: Text characters roll vertically like a flip clock.
description: Each character animates upward through the alphabet or digit set before settling on the target character.
use_when: Score displays, counters, or time-based elements.
avoid_when: Reading new text: the roll-up animation masks content during transition.
a11y: Text is readable after animation settles but hidden during the roll.

name: primitives-texts-sliding-number
title: Sliding Number
blurb: Number slides up or down to its target value.
description: Animates a numeric value by sliding it vertically from current to target position, often triggered by scroll or on mount.
use_when: Stat counters or progress displays.
avoid_when: Frequently changing values: repeated slides can feel janky.
a11y: Target number is readable after slide completes.

name: primitives-texts-scrolling-number
title: Scrolling Number
blurb: Numbers scroll vertically like a carousel of digits.
description: Renders a set of digit containers that scroll through available numbers, useful for displaying stats or odometers.
use_when: Metrics dashboards or live-updating counters.
avoid_when: High-frequency updates: rapid scrolling becomes a blur.
a11y: Only the visible digit is readable at any moment.

name: primitives-texts-morphing
title: Morphing Text
blurb: Text smoothly animates between words in a cycling list.
description: Morphs between a series of words with a canvas or SVG-based animation that blends letter shapes.
use_when: Dynamic taglines or feature descriptions cycling through related terms.
avoid_when: Large word lists: morphing becomes choppy and hard to read.
a11y: Only the current morph frame is readable. No pause or pause control.
